units.source_text: 继母上旅馆来说恭维话，阿雪也巧妙地以奉承来回答。

en.t: Her stepmother came up to the inn and offered compliments, and Ayuki answered just as skillfully with flattery of her own.

units.source_text: 继母去洗温泉澡，她蹑足去瞧了瞧，然后对老板娘说：

en.t: When her stepmother went to bathe in the hot spring, she tiptoed over to take a look, then said to the proprietress:
